Name: GetDeviceAggregation
Parameters: (orgId:string="", siteId:string="", siteKey:string="", equipId:string="", equipKey:string="", pointId:string="", pointKey:string="", startDateTime:datetime=datetime(null), endDateTime:datetime=datetime(null), rollup:string="avg", timeWindow:string="15m")
DocString: Temporal aggregation for one org (orgId GUID, REQUIRED). Resamples telemetry into timeWindow buckets (default 15m) and rolls up via a single rollup (avg|min|max|sum|count, default avg) applied to all metrics. site/equip/point accept comma-separated Id (GUID) OR Key (human) lists; Id list wins; filters are PARTIAL (unknowns reported in notFound). Default range = last 24h. ALWAYS one result object: {error:...} only on an org-level problem (INVALID_PARAMETER / ORG_NOT_FOUND), else {orgId,orgKey,equipment:[{resource,metrics:[...incl latest PointAttributes],points:[{timestamp,<metricName>:value}]}],notFound:{sites,equipment,points}}. Supersedes GetAggregatedMetrics.
